title: Yummy Peruvian Bread Bowl
description: A yeasty, crunchy bread bowl stuffed with spicy ssamjang, caramelized pineapple, roasted peanuts, and fresh cilantro, ideal for a hangover cure and temple-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
In a large bowl, whisk flour, salt, sugar, and yeast together.
Add warm water and olive oil to the dry mixture and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough, shape it into a flat disc, then cut a small square from the center to create a hollow.
Place the dough disc on the prepared sheet and bake for 25 minutes until golden and hollow.
While the bread bakes, blend ssamjang, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
When the bread is done, remove it, let it cool slightly, then gently press the edges inward to form a bowl shape.
Fill the hollow with caramelized pineapple, roasted peanuts, and the ssamjang mixture.
Top the filling with fresh cilantro, sesame seeds, and a drizzle of olive oil before serving.
Serve warm and enjoy a crunchy, savory, and herbal Peruvian bowl perfect for a quick hangover cure.
